text: Figure 7.3: Execution of a mode switch provided by an Application Software Cluster • The mode manager software component calls the Rte_Switch API to do the mode switch notification • The Cross Cluster Communication gets notified via the call of the Rte_ Rips_Switch Service. • If the mode queue is empty , this Rte_Rips_Switch can be used to determine the first on-transition value. • The Cross Cluster Communication in the Application Software Cluster informs the Cross Cluster Communication in the Host Soft- ware Cluster that a mode switch starts. This notification is a Cross Cluster Communication internal interface, which is not standardized. • After the start of the mode switch on the host, the according mode switch tasks are scheduled (potentially on multiple partitions). This in turn, via Dispatchers, schedules cluster local proxy mode switch tasks. • Potentially , other proxy mode switch tasks are scheduled before and after.
